subject: Redefine Profile v2 per D-coord-012
body: Supersede D-contracts-003: states[] 1..3, ordered strategy.steps[] {modality, direction, content, submodalities}, anchorStep, contrast, differences[] with ratingDelta, drivers[], test, futurePace, calibration (peak + contrast), confirmedAt.
